votes.motion: Approve the January 17, 2023 work session minutes.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from January 17, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Homeless Resource Center Text Amendment and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed HRC overlay zoning district and related standards amendment, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 865 South 500 East and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone from RMF-30 to CN and associated Central Community Master Plan amendment, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Marathon Petroleum Community Investment Grant application and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Fire Department's grant application to Marathon Petroleum for Training Tower improvements, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 16 of 2023, requiring increased electric infrastructure at twenty percent of parking spaces in multi-family construction and major reconstruction projects.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending City code 21A.44.040 to require electrical capacity for future EV charging stations at 20% of off-street parking stalls in new and substantially reconstructed multi-family developments.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 17 of 2023 amending ADU regulations, including removal of conditional use requirements for ADUs, maximum detached ADU size of 1,000 sq ft, owner occupancy requirement, setback and parking standards, and related legislative intents.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending Title 21A ADU regulations to lower zoning barriers, eliminate conditional use requirements for detached ADUs in single-family zones, retain owner occupancy requirements, and establish parking and setback standards; the Council also adopted legislative intents regarding a three-year review, $1 million in funding support, and two additional civil enforcement employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 04 of 2023, Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 130 N 2100 W, with a condition requiring a development agreement for sound attenuation in new or substantially remodeled structures.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance removing the AFPP Overlay District Influence Zone B from a property at 130 North 2100 West, conditioned on a development agreement requiring sound attenuation, to allow the existing hotel building to operate as permanent supportive housing primarily for seniors aged 62 and older.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda, other than items 8, 9, and 10.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items, which included setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and approving board appointments for Hoang Nguyen (Airport Board), Joseph Murphy (CDCIP Advisory Board), Alla Chernenko (Bicycle Advisory Committee), and Talula Pontuti (PNUT Advisory Board).
